Message:
scsi: lpfc: Set PU field when providing D_ID in XMIT_ELS_RSP64_CX iocb

When providing a D_ID in XMIT_ELS_RSP64_CX iocb the PU field should
be set to 3 to describe the parameter being passed to firmware.
